text.card: K2-32B is a star of 3,190 K, bound to K2-32 2,316 AU away.
text.introduction: K2-32B shares its motion through space with K2-32, 2,316 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

notes: K2-32B's orbit around K2-32 is not measured; both stars are placed at their Gaia DR3 positions, which is where they are
